svg.title: Expected completion time against restart cutoff when each run hangs forever with probability q, for q = 0.01, 0.05 and 0.2, with lognormal finishing times.
svg.desc: Exact. Finishing runs lognormal(0, 1); relaunch cost 0. Optima: q 0.01: tau* 1.658, E 1.495; q 0.05: tau* 1.462, E 1.594; q 0.2: tau* 1.144, E 2.016.
svg.text: restart cutoff τ, in multiples of the median of a run that finishes
